notes.title: Big Update 1.0.3: In-Game Shop! New exclusive Skins and evil Raven Viggo!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155386/3fdb0619641c972b7adc8c1ccd7a8b525794f80a.png

Dear friends! The long awaited Update 1.0.3 is finally here and it brings you cool In-Game Shop with new exclusive outfits (Skins) for your hedgehog, Powerup bonuses, New hot "Lava" platforms and of course, the one and only, evil Raven Viggo! Here's the full list of improvements:

- Evil Raven Viggo
- In-Game Shop with Skins, Powerups and Hearts (Lives)
- You can spend collected Coins on any item in the Shop
- 8 all new, exclusive Skins for your hedgehog
- Main Game Menu
- Slightly changed Hearts (Lives) logic *
- You can increase duration of Magnet and Shield in a Shop
- You can buy additional Hearts (Lives) in a Shop (for Coins)
- You can toggle Music and SFX sounds on/off now
- New hot "Lava" platforms
- Slight redesign of old Platforms
- All Coins, Lives and Skins are saved
- UI was slightly redesigned, icons added

* Now, if you run out of Hearts (Lives), you will have to restart the game - in this case, all of your Coins will be reset to 0 and your Hearts will be reset to default 3, enabling you to try collecting more in the next round. All of your Skins and Powerups which you collected earlier - will remain intact - no worries!

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.2 – Tricky Wrecked Platforms!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155386/c8f14dc4731373acad1b5b6fb94580e59f0374fa.png

Hello Friends! Our next minor update 1.0.2 is live and it brings even more shiny coins to collect! Also, today we introduce new and tricky - wrecked type of platforms with Magnet Power-Ups that are a bit harder to get as you will need to swoop down under the platforms and quickly jump out of them accurately to get them! We also squeezed some nasty bugs and did some minor optimizations and fixes to UI. 

Full list of improvements:

- Two new wrecked platforms with Power-Ups (Magnets)
- There are more coins now and they appear more often.
- Bug when ground enemies were sometimes able to make double damage is fixed.
- Some minor UI issues causing menu screens sometimes to overlap is fixed.

Oh and one more thing :) We want to thank all of you for support and valuable feedback! If you have any questions, suggestions or you just.. you know, feel a bit lonely, please don’t hesitate to leave us a message in the discussions area. We would be glad to help and chit-chat :) Let us know what you think about this update! Stay tuned - more cool things to come soon!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Achievements and Leaderboards!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155386/5290f2d72984e17f8cc320e35805fd1065c65d36.jpg

We're happy to announce that our next 1.0.1 update is live and it contains long awaited cool and shiny Steam Achievements for you to conquer and Leaderboards to check your rankings globally or among your friends! 

Full list of improvements:

- 45 Steam Achievements added
- Leaderboards 
- Different time of day (Darker environment) 
- Glowing Power Ups (Magnets and Shields are now glowing and emitting light)
- Joumee is lighting the way around him with a cool subtle light 

Let us know what you think about this update! 
More cool things to come soon!
